title: Supplier inspection cohorts
bodyMd:
Each inspected component is classified as accepted or rejected once. Cohort sizes differ, so absolute acceptances alone do not measure quality.

| Category | Inspected components | Accepted components |
|---|---:|---:|
| Forge | 100 | 85 |
| Mould | 200 | 180 |
| Assembly | 300 | 255 |
